quirks.summary: The register is a Salesforce Lightning single-page app: plain HTTP gets the app shell, and the data loads through the site's Aura controllers.
quirks.detail: Treated as browser-only on the same basis the skill applies to Arcus: no supported anonymous API, and replaying the controllers is out of scope. PlanIt's applics records carry the record deep links but no docs_url.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser_route or the PlanIt record link.

browser_route.note: Search the reference in the register. Where PlanIt has the record, its url is the detail deep link (https://planning.eastleigh.gov.uk/s/papplication/<recordId>).

robots.note: Default Salesforce communities robots.txt: 'Allow: /' for all user agents. Retrieval is browser-only regardless, because the register exposes no anonymous data API.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; no vendor fingerprint matched; WAF signals: cloudflare

One GET of the register returned the Salesforce Lightning shell (Cloudflare in front, passive) with no register data and no product namespace; PlanIt's applics records gave /s/papplication/<id> deep links and no document host. No attempt was made on the Aura controllers. robots.txt fetched. Dropped the 'vendor-unverified' quirk (replaced by the fingerprint above) and the 'waf-present' quirk (the obstacle is the SPA, not the WAF). Modern.gov GetCommittees checked.
